title: E-RLT-0113: the taxicab control, pass: a particle that is a looped list of unit axis steps (the Matter As Machine...
purpose: Experiment E-RLT-0113 in the relativity arena: the taxicab control, pass: a particle that is a looped list of unit axis steps (the Matter As Machine model, built as an external control) has top speed 1 on an axis and 1 / sqrt 3 on a body diagonal at every loop length, spread 0.605 over 37 husk directions at N = 12 to 768, order 0, anisotropic at leading order; Vibe's husk photon on the same directions has spread 1.7e-4 at |k| = 0.8 falling as $|k|^{4.00}$ to 1.6e-10 at 0.025, the D4 set at order 4.04 against a hypercubic 2.01; this clears Vibe's light, while its matter on the working rule moves on lines and is anisotropic at leading order too (E-SPN-0126).
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
